6.why: Area and volume calculations are somewhat manageable. I have basic skills but often doubt my accuracy under pressure.

7.why: Sketching curves requires advanced understanding I do not possess. I feel not at all confident in this graphical task.

8.why: Fractions are tricky but not impossible for me. I am moderately confident though I prefer chemistry or physics.

9.why: Finding missing side lengths is hard for me. I struggle with geometric proofs and feel not at all confident.
